messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: multiple driver reset / Xid errors observed on cluster-serving-gpu. Metric spike: driver_resets 42 -> 190 in 5m, nodename(s): gpu-node-17, gpu-node-22, gpu-node-03. Symptoms: pod restarts, degraded tail latency 200-600ms. Auto-evac rule triggered on gpu-node-17. Please triage and escalate if needed.

maria: acked. I'm oncall. seeing the same in grafana. starting triage — checking dmesg + kube events.

sunil: I'm available to help infra side. which pool is this hitting?

maria: Serving-runtime pool: inference-prod-gpu. Affected replicas are autoscaled inference deployments (100-200ms baseline).

katie: any customer-facing impact yet? Jamal, can you check SLO-alerts/health checks?

jamal: customer-impact: some inference requests are returning 502/503 during driver_reset spikes, roughly 2% of customer requests routed to affected nodes. Not a full outage but degraded for a couple of high-throughput tenants. Opening bridge if needed.

sunil: pulling node logs. dmesg shows repeated NVRM: Xid 43 errors and 'NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus' followed by 'kernel: Out of memory' on kubelet side for one pod.

maria: copying logs.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook suggestion: cordon + drain the node, restart GPU driver (modprobe/unload), and do a controlled rolling restart of inference pods. See /runbooks/gpu-driver-reset.

maria: Proposed immediate actions: 1) cordon gpu-node-17 2) drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data 3) scale down heavy long-running jobs if any 4) enable fallback-route to cpu-pool for high-latency requests.

katie: +1 on cordon/drain. Add a short canary to ensure fallback works before mass drain.

sunil: I'm going to attempt a controlled driver reload on gpu-node-22 after cordon. If driver reload fails, we'll evacuate to CPU pool and reimage.

maria: executing commands now:```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --force --delete-local-data
```

maria: drain started. pods are terminating gracefully. scheduler is rescheduling to other nodes.

jamal: Notifying affected accounts: sending a short note to support queue, flagging tenants A and C. cc: account-owners.

sunil: quick diagnostic from node before driver ops:```bash
# tail dmesg
[ 1023.421] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 43
[ 1023.425] NVRM: GPU 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1023.430] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 45321 (python) total-vm:12000000kB
```

sunil: trying:```bash
sudo modprobe -r nvidia_uvm && sudo modprobe nvidia_uvm
sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced || true
sudo systemctl restart kubelet
```

maria: progress update: gpu-node-17 drained, pods rescheduled. latency for affected requests dropped back to baseline for most traffic, some residual 502 spikes while LB drains.

katie: good. what's the plan for gpu-node-22? Is it safe to attempt reload there?

sunil: gpu-node-22 shows less frequent Xid but present. I'll attempt reload during a short maintenance window; if reload yields repeated Xid we should reimage. I'll also collect nv-host logs and dmesg.

ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: if you see persistent Xid > 5/min on a node after driver reload, escalate to infra and consider cordon + reimage. Document kernel/driver versions and attach to ticket.

maria: opening incident ticket INC-241500: summary + actions taken, linking logs and customer impact. Attaching nv-host logs and stack traces.

jamal: sent customer notifications to tenants A/C with mitigation steps and ETA for full remediation. kept communication brief, noted degraded latency and mitigation (evacuation to CPU fallback).

katie: once we stabilize, let's do a canary patch of newer NVIDIA driver on one isolated node in staging and run inference load. If that passes, schedule rolling upgrade.

sunil: starting driver upgrade on staging now. will report results in ~30m.

maria: handing off to sunil for infra follow-up. I'll remain reachable for customer comms. Next oncall, please pick up post-mortem items: root cause hypothesis, whether kernel patch or hardware ECC flagged, and if firmware update needed.

sunil: takeover ack. I'll monitor driver reload results and flag if reimage required. will create infra ticket with node hardware telemetry + GPU ECC counters.

maria: thanks team — marking this thread as live-incident -> elevated -> mitigated for the initial node. I'll update incident timeline in the ticket and add next steps for RCA.

incident-bot: Incident status update: mitigated (partial) — node gpu-node-17 evacuated, customer-impact reduced. Tracking: INV-241500 (INC-241500). Oncall handoff to sunil at 2415006300.

sunil: final note before next shift: commands used and log pointers in ticket. If you see any repeat within the hour, enable global fallback-route and abort new deployments to inference-prod-gpu until RCA complete.

maria: thanks, handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
